name: PartsSpecialOrderTracker
tagline: Every special-order part from request to collection – deposits, ETAs, back-orders, the shelf and supplier scorecards in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete special-order parts desk for automotive dealers. Take the request at the counter or against a repair order, order from the right supplier with the reference and an ETA from the promised lead time, enforce the deposit policy for non-returnable parts, record back-orders, receive into a bin, notify customers and send reminders, collect the balance – or return to stock with the restocking fee shown – and score suppliers on lead time and on-time delivery. Works the moment it is dropped (demo mode), then binds to a collection, Dataverse, SharePoint, Excel or SQL, a model-driven view or the Power Pages Web API.
features: 10 KPI tiles: open lines, awaiting order, on-order value, overdue ETAs, back-orders, not notified, uncollected value, return-to-stock candidates, deposit short, lead time and on-time %
Pipeline board with drag-and-drop and rule-checked moves
Deposit policy (percent over a threshold) enforced for non-returnable parts
Supplier order ref and ETA from each supplier's promised lead time; back-orders with reason and new ETA
Receive into a bin; single and bulk customer notifications with counts and reminders
Collection with balance check or issue to the workshop repair order
Collection shelf aging buckets and return-to-stock decisions with restocking fee or write-off
Supplier scorecards: actual vs promised lead time, on-time %, chase list
Search, filters, grouping, bulk notify / return / cancel / assign / export / delete with Undo
Power Fx outputs and events: OnSelect, OnChange, OnCreate, OnSave, OnAction, OnStatusChange
Phone layout with bottom navigation and column switchers; keyboard shortcuts and ARIA
